name: headcount
title_zh: 把 Claude Code 组织成一家有 15 个部
tagline_zh: 125+ 个技能按部门归档，像入职一样按需领取。不用再在散装技能堆里翻找，直接按组织架构调用。
tagline_en: 125+ skills filed by department, pick what you need like onboarding. No more digging through loose skills—call by.
desc_en: An agent organization for Claude Code, structured as a company — 15+ departments, 125+ skills, each independently installable.
why_zh: 不是平铺清单，而是有层级的组织。技能按职责分组，跨部门协作有默认路径，装一个部门就能获得该岗位的完整工。
why_en: Not a flat list but a hierarchy. Skills grouped by role, cross-department flows have defaults—install one dept and get that.
limit_zh: 只适配 Claude Code，不含其他 Agent 运行时。125+ 技能需逐个安装，没有一键全装。
limit_en: Claude Code only, no other runtimes. 125+ skills install individually, no bulk install; cross-dept deps need manual confirmation, no auto-rollback.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
